hypothesis: Stock momentum with a trend brake, on fake money beside the real Momentum account.
rules: At the first session of each month: today's S&P 500 members, ranked by 12-1 momentum (research_harness/sleeves/momo_v1.momentum_12_1); top 50. Book index = equal-weight average of the 50 names' closes relative to their selection-day close. Trend brake: index below its 100-session average -> all 50 to cash; re-entry only at the next month's first session. s = min(1, 0.15 / 20-session volatility of the index), set at entry. Each name 2% x s.
universe: S&P 500 current members (State Street SPY holdings file, iShares IVV fallback; same source as MOMO-V2). Today's list, not point-in-time: a known survivorship tilt, small for a forward-only record.
rebalance_day: first session of each month + brake changes
leverage: no borrowing: weights add to at most 100% (max_gross 1.0). Effective exposure above 1x only through 2x funds.
fills: decision after a session close, filled at the next session's open (twins engine = research_harness/harness/portfolio.simulate)
costs: one shared model for every line: twins.config.SHARE_COSTS = 0 commission, 2 bps half spread, 3 bps slippage per trade (estimates; monthly re-measure from the real accounts' fills is a later work order). Gearing only through 2x funds (SSO, QLD), whose borrowing cost is inside their price; no margin. Idle money in BIL (T-bills); plain cash earns 0.
data_needed: daily bars of every member, 380+ sessions (Alpaca)
window: forward only: version 1 from the first session after the lock to 31 Dec 2027 (roadmap Phase 2). No backtest stands behind this line in the league.

pass_bar: Roadmap Phase 4 (January 2028): passes if, after costs, it matched or beat the S&P 500 (Y-SPX), or came close with a clearly smaller worst fall, AND passes the luck check adjusted for 16 tries (deflated Sharpe: research_harness/harness/overfit.deflated_sharpe with n_trials = 16).
